reviews.title: False alarm all the time
reviews.text: I bought so many apps, and this is the worst app I have ever experienced, my phone and watch are on my hands and triggers alarms several times in the 1st day of install. The Bluetooth signal is 100% why it triggers the alarm? I was driving and it triggered alarm and it made my wife so mad. I am a software engineer for over 30 years, can you work with me to fix this app? I need this app so I don’t lose my iPhone. It’s very annoying for false alarms, this app not really difficult to do right? Just check the Bluetooth signal strength and..
